description: Stock solutions of IAA and NAA were prepared in 95% ethanol and K-NAA in deionized water, stored appropriately, and diluted into cooled NGM agar plates seeded with E. coli OP50 for auxin treatment experiments.
goal: to prepare auxin-containing media for experiments

title: Perform auxin treatment experiments
description: Synchronized L1 larvae were transferred to NGM plates or M9 buffer containing various auxins and bacteria at specific developmental stages for degradation experiments.
goal: to induce auxin-mediated protein degradation

title: Construct pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids
description: Clone synthetic gDNAs between two tracrRNA-complementary repeat regions in the pCRISPR-SacB plasmid to generate plasmids encoding RNA guides for Cas9 targeting.
goal: to create plasmids encoding guide RNAs for Cas9-mediated genome editing

title: Test gDNA efficiency by transformation and colony counting
description: Transform E. coli with pCRISPR-SacB plasmids carrying different gDNAs and compare transformation efficiencies to the empty vector to assess gDNA efficiency in promoting Cas9 cleavage.
goal: to evaluate the effectiveness of gDNAs in driving Cas9 cleavage
key_materials: LB plates with Cm and Km

title: Analyze plasmid and chromosomal sequences of transformants
description: Randomly select colonies from transformations and analyze both chromosomal target sites and plasmid gDNA regions by PCR and sequencing to detect mutations or plasmid rearrangements.
goal: to verify the integrity of gDNA sequences and target sites after transformation

title: Optimize gene knockout conditions using donor DNA
description: Test different lengths (70 and 120 bp), concentrations (10 μg), and types (ss-dDNA targeting lagging or leading strand, ds-dDNA) of donor DNA to determine optimal conditions for gene deletions of varying sizes.
goal: to determine optimal parameters for efficient gene inactivation

title: Validate gene deletion efficiency across multiple loci
description: Apply optimized donor DNA conditions to target multiple gene loci and measure mutation efficiencies by analyzing at least 20 colonies per experiment.
goal: to confirm robustness and efficiency of gene deletion protocol
key_materials: pCRISPR plasmids targeting ompF, fecA, lpp genes

title: Generate and test 78 pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids for dispensable genes
description: Construct plasmids encoding gRNAs targeting 78 dispensable genes near their 5' ends and verify gDNA effectiveness by transformation and colony counting.
goal: to create a mutant library targeting dispensable genes

title: Perform 30 bp deletions with 70 bp ss-dDNAs in 78 genes
description: Transform E. coli with each pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid and corresponding 70 bp ss-dDNA to delete 30 bp and introduce premature stop codons, then analyze 10 colonies per gene by PCR to assess mutagenesis efficiency.
goal: to validate the efficiency of short gene deletions for mutant library production

title: Transform E. coli with pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids
description: Transform E. coli BL21(DE3)ΔompA strain carrying pCasRed plasmid with the constructed pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids and select transformants on LB plates supplemented with Cm and Km antibiotics.
goal: to introduce CRISPR/Cas9 components and gDNA into E. coli for genome editing
key_materials: LB plates with chloramphenicol (Cm) and kanamycin (Km)

title: Prepare PLX5622 and control chow
description: PLX5622 was formulated at 300 ppm in AIN-76A standard chow. Mice ingested approximately 1.2 mg of PLX5622 per day based on 4 g chow consumption.
goal: to provide drug-containing and control diets for mice

title: Generate CX3CR1+/GFP/CCR2+/RFP mice
description: CX3CR1+/GFP/CCR2+/RFP animals were generated by crossing CX3CR1 GFP/GFP/CCR2 RFP/RFP mice with C57BL/6J mice as previously described.

title: Treat mice with PLX5622 or control chow
description: Starting at 8 weeks old, C57BL/6J mice were treated with PLX5622 or control chow for 21 days.

title: Perform cranial irradiation on mice
description: Mice were anesthetized with ketamine/xylazine and irradiated with 1.65 Gy on both sides of the head per fraction, three fractions every other day over 5 days to total 10 Gy. Eyes, body, and trachea were shielded. Sham animals underwent the same procedure without radiation.
goal: to deliver fractionated cranial irradiation to mice

title: Conduct novel object recognition (NOR) test
description: Mice were habituated and tested in a reversed light cycle room. They explored an open arena for 10 min on two days, then explored two identical objects for 5 min, followed by one familiar and one novel object for 5 min. Behavior was recorded and analyzed for exploratory behavior.
goal: to assess recognition memory in mice

title: Perform delayed matching-to-place (DMP) dry maze test
description: Mice were given four trials per day with 10 min intervals. They were placed under a dark box for 30 s, then allowed 90 s to find the escape hole. Noise and bright light were used as stimuli. Maze and escape tube were cleaned with ethanol between trials.
goal: to measure spatial working memory

title: Conduct metric distance test
description: Over two days, mice were habituated and tested with objects placed at varying distances (28 cm, 14 cm, 21 cm) in the arena. Exploration time was recorded and analyzed to assess hippocampal function.
goal: to evaluate hippocampal-dependent spatial discrimination

title: Isolate brain cells for flow cytometry
description: Brains were perfused and dissociated. Cells were separated by Percoll gradient centrifugation, blocked, stained with antibodies, and analyzed by flow cytometry to identify immune cell populations.
key_materials: Fluorophore-conjugated antibodies (CD45-BV711, CD11b-AF700, Ly6C-Pacific Blue, Ly6G-PE)

title: Worm Strain Culturing and Maintenance
description: Worms were grown and maintained on nematode growth media plates seeded with E. coli (OP50) at 20°C. Various worm strains were created by crossing specific genotypes and using CRISPR-Cas9 techniques.
goal: to culture and maintain worm strains for experiments

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Genome Editing
description: CRISPR-Cas9 was used to create GFP-tagged rad-51 and spo-11 mutations in specific worm strains. The GFP tag was added to the N-terminus of RAD-51, and spo-11 deletions or insertions were generated and confirmed by phenotypic analysis.
goal: to create GFP-tagged rad-51 and spo-11 mutant worm strains

title: Live Worm Imaging
description: Live worms were imaged using fluorescence microscopy with specific exposure settings. Nuclei were located based on GFP fluorescence, and time series imaging was performed to monitor foci formation and dynamics after microirradiation.
goal: to image live worms and monitor fluorescent foci dynamics

title: Image Processing and Foci Scoring
description: Image stacks from live imaging were processed to create maximum projections. Foci in nuclei were counted and measured for size, with clusters defined by diameter. Background fluorescence and worm viability were assessed during scoring.
goal: to quantify and analyze fluorescent foci in live imaging data

title: Fixed Slide Imaging and Analysis
description: Fixed slides were imaged using wide-field fluorescence microscopy and deconvolved. Gonad length and foci locations were recorded and analyzed, with focus clusters identified by size criteria.
goal: to image and analyze fixed worm gonads for foci distribution

title: Microirradiation of Germline Nuclei
description: Target nuclei in the germline were microirradiated with a single laser pulse at specified intensities. Multiple nuclei per gonad were targeted, and worms were recovered post-irradiation for further analysis.
goal: to induce DNA damage in germline nuclei via microirradiation

title: Live Imaging Slide Preparation
description: Worms were positioned on agarose pads or in petri dishes with M9 and polystyrene beads for live imaging and microirradiation. After imaging, worms were recovered by removing coverslips or agarose pads and placed on NGM plates.
goal: to prepare and recover live worms for imaging and microirradiation

title: Immunofluorescent Staining of Gonads
description: Dissected worm gonads were fixed and stained with specific primary and secondary antibodies to detect proteins of interest. Gonads were also stained with DAPI to visualize DNA.
goal: to stain worm gonads for immunofluorescence microscopy
key_materials: Primary antibodies: anti-RAD-51, anti-GFP, anti-HIM-8, anti-SYP-1

title: Animal Housing and Food Restriction
description: Male 3-month old BALB/cARC and C57BL/6JARC mice were housed in groups of four in ventilated cages with bedding under controlled temperature, humidity, and light cycle. Mice were food-restricted to 90% of their free-feeding body weight by adjusting daily food amounts, with ad libitum access to water.
goal: to maintain mice under controlled environmental conditions and food restriction for behavioral testing

title: Touchscreen Apparatus Setup and Habituation
description: Operant chambers equipped with touchscreen and reward systems were used for testing. Mice were habituated in a dimly lit room for at least 30 minutes before sessions. The apparatus was cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals and reward lines flushed daily.
goal: to prepare and habituate mice to the touchscreen testing environment

title: Touchscreen Training with Liquid Reward
description: Mice were acclimated to a liquid reward by providing strawberry milk in their home cage for 3 days. They progressed through touchscreen training stages including Habituation, Initial Touch, Must Touch Stimuli, Must Initiate, and Punish Incorrect, with modifications to increase trial pace and reduce distractions.
goal: to train mice to use the touchscreen and respond to stimuli for reward

title: Visual Discrimination (VD) Task
description: Mice were trained to discriminate between two visual stimuli, with one stimulus rewarded. They completed 100 trials within 60 minutes and had to achieve at least 80% correct responses. Correction trials were used to prevent side bias.
goal: to assess visual discrimination learning in mice

title: Reversal Learning Task
description: After acquiring the VD task, the reward contingencies were reversed so that the previously unrewarded stimulus became correct. Mice were tested until reaching 80% correct or a maximum of 20 sessions to measure behavioral flexibility.
goal: to evaluate behavioral flexibility through reversal learning

title: Open Field Locomotor Activity Test
description: Mice were individually placed in a square chamber equipped with infrared beams to track movement. The chamber was cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals. Total distance traveled and percent time spent in the center were recorded over 30 minutes.
goal: to measure locomotor activity and anxiety-related behavior
key_materials: square Perspex chambers (27 × 27 × 20 cm, Med Associates Inc.)

title: Forced Swim Test (FST)
description: Mice were placed individually in a water-filled cylinder for 10 minutes while activity was recorded by overhead camera. After testing, mice were dried and returned to their home cage. Videos were analyzed for distance traveled and immobility duration.
goal: to assess behavioral despair in mice

title: Statistical Analysis of Behavioral Data
description: Behavioral data were analyzed using independent t-tests, ANOVA, or repeated measures ANOVA with Bonferroni correction. Greenhouse-Geisser correction was applied when necessary. Significance was set at p < 0.05.
goal: to analyze behavioral outcomes statistically

title: Cell culture maintenance
description: DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells were maintained as described previously.

title: iChIP-Seq and in vitro enChIP-Seq procedures
description: Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells were subjected to the iChIP procedure, and DT40 cells were subjected to the in vitro enChIP procedure. Chromatin DNA was fragmented (~2 kbp), target regions isolated, DNA purified, libraries prepared concentrating ~0.4 kbp fragments, and sequenced using the HiSeq platform. Data were analyzed and mapped to the galGal4 genome.
goal: to isolate and sequence target chromatin regions

title: NGS data analysis and peak detection
description: NGS data were mapped onto the galGal4 reference genome using ELAND. Narrow peaks in iChIP-Seq datasets were detected using MACS2 with default parameters. Images of NGS peaks were generated using IGV.
goal: to analyze sequencing data and identify binding peaks

title: Plasmid construction for sgRNA expression
description: Double-stranded DNA encoding target sequences was cloned downstream of the U6 promoter in the sgRNA expression plasmid. Alternatively, DNA fragments coding the U6 promoter, target sequence, gRNA scaffold, and termination signal were synthesized and cloned into plasmids.
key_materials: GeneArt gene synthesis services (Thermo Fisher Scientific)

title: CRISPR-mediated genomic locus deletion
description: DT40 cells were transfected with Cas9 and sgRNA plasmids targeting genomic region ends and pEGFP-N3 by electroporation. GFP-positive cells were sorted and expanded. Genomic DNA was extracted and genotyping PCR was performed to confirm deletion.
goal: to delete specific genomic loci using CRISPR

title: RNA extraction and quantitative RT-PCR
description: Total RNA was extracted and quantitative RT-PCR was performed as described previously using primers listed in Supplementary Table S1.

title: Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assays
description: ChIP assays were performed with DT40 cells and specific antibodies. Purified DNA was used as template for real-time PCR to analyze enrichment at target loci.
key_materials: Applied Biosystems 7900HT Fast Real-Time PCR System

title: DSS Treatment of Mice
description: C57BL/6 mice were housed under controlled conditions and given 3% DSS in drinking water for 7 days. After treatment, mice were sacrificed by CO2 euthanasia and proximal colon tissue was collected for RNA extraction.
goal: to induce DSS treatment in mice for experimental analysis

title: RNA Extraction from Colon Tissue
description: Total RNA was isolated from colonic tissues using TRIzol reagent following the manufacturer's instructions. RNA integrity was assessed by 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.

title: Lithium Chloride RNA Purification
description: RNA samples were incubated with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl on ice for 2 hours, centrifuged, and pellets dissolved in RNase-free water. This process was repeated once. RNA was then precipitated with sodium acetate and ethanol at -20°C, centrifuged, washed with 70% ethanol, and dissolved in RNase-free water to remove polysaccharides including DSS.
goal: to purify RNA from polysaccharides including DSS

title: cDNA Synthesis and qPCR
description: cDNA was synthesized from total RNA using a commercial kit. Quantitative PCR was performed using SYBR Green chemistry to quantify gene expression with specific primers for 36B4.
key_materials: Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (Thermo Scientific)
Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix (Thermo Scientific)

title: Polymerase Enzymatic Activity Assay
description: Recombinant Taq DNA polymerase was incubated with water or varying concentrations of DSS, with dextran as a control. Polymerase activity was measured fluorometrically every minute for 60 minutes during the elongation step at 72°C.
key_materials: EvaEZ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit (Biotium)

title: Measure polymerase enzymatic activity
description: Recombinant Taq DNA polymerase was incubated with water or DSS at various concentrations. The enzymatic activity was quantified by fluorescence measured every minute for 60 minutes during the elongation step at 72°C.
goal: to measure polymerase enzymatic activity
key_materials: EvaEZ™ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit

title: Measure reverse transcriptase enzymatic activity
description: M-MuLV reverse transcriptase was incubated at 25°C with water or DSS in the presence of a standardized polyA RNA template, oligodT, and polymerization buffer. The enzymatic activity was quantified by fluorescence.
goal: to measure reverse transcriptase enzymatic activity

title: Perform surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding assay
description: Gold sensor chips covered with carboxydextran were activated with EDC/NHS to couple purified M-MuLV reverse transcriptase. Primed RNA, with or without DSS at different concentrations, was flowed over the chip. Binding interactions were detected in real time by measuring resonance angle deviations (laser deflection) in mDegrees.
goal: to assess binding affinity between reverse transcriptase and primed RNA with or without DSS

title: Isolate plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells
description: Plasma cells were obtained from synovial fluid of an anti-CCP–positive RA patient, and antibody-secreting cells were isolated from synovial fluid mononuclear cells using the fluorescent foci method.
goal: to isolate plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells from synovial fluid

title: Sort single citrulline-specific B cells by flow cytometry
description: Single citrulline-specific B cells were sorted by flow cytometry from peripheral blood of RA patients using an antigen-tetramer system.
goal: to isolate single citrulline-specific B cells

title: Perform peptide ELISA for antibody binding
description: Peptide ELISAs assessed binding of monoclonal antibodies to citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides including filaggrin, α-enolase, vimentin, fibrinogen, and histones. mAb were added at 5 μg/ml and serially diluted down to 0.15 ng/ml. Reactive samples were analyzed in at least 3 independent experiments.
goal: to assess antibody binding to citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides

title: Conduct full-length protein ELISA with citrullination
description: Full-length proteins were coated on 96-well plates, blocked with 5% milk in PBS, and incubated with citrullination buffer containing hPAD2 or buffer control at 37°C for 3 hours. Plates were then incubated with ACPAs at 5 μg/ml serially diluted to 0.15 ng/ml, followed by sequential incubation with secondary HRP-conjugated antibodies and development with TMB substrate. Results were read using a Spectra Fluor reader.
goal: to detect antibody binding to citrullinated full-length proteins

title: Synthesize extracellular matrix peptide microarray
description: Peptides covering all arginine and lysine sites of 1,610 extracellular matrix and RA-related proteins were synthesized in situ, including citrulline and homocitrulline variants, resulting in a total of 172,765 unique peptides.

title: Dilute monoclonal antibodies and samples
description: Monoclonal antibodies were diluted to 1 μg/ml (except mAb 1325:07E07 at 0.55 μg/ml), and synovial fluid and serum samples were diluted 1/100 for subsequent analysis.

title: Scan peptide microarray for antibody reactivity
description: Scanning for citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with each monoclonal antibody was performed at 2 μm resolution, and median fluorescence intensities were calculated based on a 25-pixel spot size. Positive signals were defined as 5 times the fluorescence intensity of the 98th percentile of non-ACPA mAb values.
goal: to detect citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity

title: Perform Western blot analysis of full-length proteins
description: Full-length proteins were solubilized in 8 M urea at 1 mg/ml, electrophoresed on 12.5% SDS-PAGE gels, and transferred to nitrocellulose membranes. Membranes were incubated overnight at 37°C with citrullination buffer containing 150 mU/ml hPAD2 or buffer control, followed by incubation with ACPAs at 5 μg/ml and secondary antibody. Visualization was performed using Amersham Hyperfilm.

title: Preparation of cell-conditioned medium
description: Cells were cultured in DMEM with 10% fetal bovine serum at 37°C and 5% CO2 or in serum-free formulations. Recombinant ribonuclease inhibitor was added at 4–8 U/ml during medium renewal or after collection of conditioned media.

title: Ultracentrifugation of cell-conditioned medium
description: Cell-conditioned medium previously centrifuged at 2000 × g was ultracentrifuged at 100,000 × g for 2.5 hours at 4°C. The supernatant was concentrated to approximately 250 μl using ultrafiltration units and then used for size-exclusion chromatography or RNA extraction with TRIzol.

title: Size-exclusion chromatography of extracellular fractions
description: 100,000 × g supernatants were concentrated by ultrafiltration with PBS to remove phenol red and small molecules. Concentrated EV-depleted fractions (500 μl) were injected into a Superdex S200 column and run at 0.9 ml/min in filtered PBS. Samples were centrifuged at 16,000 × g before injection. Fractions of 0.25 ml were collected while monitoring absorbance at 260 and 280 nm. Chromatograms were deconvoluted in silico using 260/280 ratios from BSA and synthetic tRNA Gly GCC 5′ halves.

title: Sequencing of small RNAs
description: RNA was purified from selected chromatographic peaks using TRIzol LS. The RNA was diluted in RNase-free water and used as input for NGS library preparation with the NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set. Sequencing was performed on a MiSeq sequencer for 200 cycles. Data analysis was performed as described in supplementary materials.
key_materials: NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina

title: Northern blotting of RNA samples
description: Northern blots were performed using 10% denaturing gels transferred to nylon membranes. Detection was based on digoxigenin-labeled DNA probes and alkaline phosphatase-labeled anti-digoxigenin antibody. Signals were visualized with CDP-Star and detected using a ChemiDoc imaging system.

title: Differentiation of dendritic cells and flow cytometry analysis
description: Adherent BMDCs were prepared as described in reference 26. Selected chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs were added to 1 × 10^6 BMDCs. After 24 hours, cells were harvested and analyzed by flow cytometry.

title: Morphology and Marker Analysis of iPS-DCregs
description: Compared morphology and expression of co-stimulatory molecules and MHC class II antigens between iPS-DCregs and BM-DCregs, assessing their immature stage characteristics.
goal: to characterize the stable immature stage of iPS-DCregs

title: Antigen Uptake Assay under IFN-γ Stimulation
description: Tested antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs under IFN-γ stimulation using FITC-labeled OVA and dextran to confirm maintenance of immature stage.
goal: to verify stable immature stage of iPS-DCregs under IFN-γ

title: mRNA Expression Analysis of Suppressive Cytokines
description: Measured mRNA levels of suppressive cytokines in iPS-DCregs compared to BM-DCcons to assess immunosuppressive properties.
goal: to identify suppressive cytokine expression in iPS-DCregs
key_materials: mRNA for TGF-β1, Arg-1, PD-L1, HO-1

title: Allogeneic Mixed Lymphocyte Reaction (MLR) for Direct Pathway
description: Set up allogeneic MLR to test direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs by measuring T cell proliferation inhibition.
goal: to examine direct regulatory function of iPS-DCregs
key_materials: naive T cells from CBA mice

title: OVA-Specific MLR for Indirect Pathway
description: Established OVA-specific MLR to investigate indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs by assessing inhibition of OVA-reactive T cell proliferation.
goal: to investigate indirect regulatory function of iPS-DCregs

title: In Vivo Proliferation Lymph Node Assay (PLNA)
description: Injected OVA-pulsed BM-DCcons with or without iPS-DCregs into mice footpads to assess in vivo regulatory function by measuring T cell proliferation in lymph nodes.
goal: to test in vivo regulatory function of iPS-DCregs

title: Immunization and Secondary In Vitro MLR
description: Immunized mice with B6 DCs, isolated spleen cells, and performed secondary MLR to evaluate Treg generation and Teff suppression.
goal: to assess Treg induction and Teff suppression by iPS-DCregs

title: Donor-Type DCregs Injection and Cardiac Allograft Survival
description: Injected different DCregs types into recipients prior to heart transplantation to evaluate allograft survival and rejection.
goal: to test donor-type iPS-DCregs in preventing allograft rejection
key_materials: CBA BM-DCregs pulsed with H-2Kb peptide

title: Grow petunia plants in greenhouse
description: Rooted petunia plantlets were obtained and grown in a greenhouse under controlled temperature (25/20°C day/night) and a 12/12 h light/dark photoperiod starting at 0800 h.
key_materials: Petunia x hybrida L. lines P720

title: Collect and analyze floral volatiles by GC–MS
description: Volatiles emitted from detached petunia flowers at different developmental stages and times were collected using adsorbent traps, eluted with hexane containing iso butylbenzene as internal standard, and analyzed by GC–MS for identification and quantification.
goal: to determine the composition and amounts of free and glycosylated scent compounds and emitted volatiles

title: Extract free volatile compounds from petal tissue
description: Petal tissues were ground in liquid nitrogen and extracted in hexane with iso butylbenzene as internal standard, incubated with shaking, centrifuged, and the supernatant prepared for GC–MS analysis.
goal: to determine the pool sizes of free volatile compounds (aglycones)

title: Extract glycosylated scent compounds from petals
description: Petal tissue was ground in liquid nitrogen, suspended in 80% methanol, sonicated, centrifuged, vacuum-dried, resuspended in citrate–phosphate buffer, hydrolyzed overnight with Viscozyme to release sugar-bound aroma compounds, then extracted with hexane containing iso butylbenzene for GC–MS analysis.
goal: to extract and analyze glycosylated scent compounds

title: Perform GC–MS analysis of volatile samples
description: Samples were injected into GC–MS with specified temperature program and conditions; mass spectra were recorded and compounds identified by spectral library matching and authentic standards.

title: Conduct 2H5-Phe feeding experiments on detached flowers
description: Detached corollas were incubated in 2H5-Phe solution for 20 min, washed, transferred to water, and limb samples collected at various time points to analyze labeled and non-labeled glycosylated scent compounds.
goal: to trace incorporation of labeled phenylalanine into scent compounds

title: Transiently overexpress AnBGL1 in petunia flowers
description: Petunia buds were vacuum infiltrated with Agrobacterium carrying AnBGL1 constructs or control GFP, flowers examined for GFP expression, glycosylated scent compounds extracted and analyzed, and β-glucosidase activity assayed using pNPG substrate.
goal: to transiently express β-glucosidase and assess its effect on scent compounds

title: Isolate protoplasts and intact vacuoles from petals
description: Protoplasts were isolated from petals and viability assessed by fluorescein diacetate staining; vacuoles were isolated by osmotic and thermal lysis followed by Ficoll step gradient centrifugation and purity evaluated by microscopy and western blot.

title: Synthesize desthiobiotin derivatives of thiazole orange acetate
description: TO1-Dtb and TO3-Dtb were synthesized using TO1-acetate and TO3-acetate respectively, with EZ link amine PEG4 desthiobiotin as precursors following an established protocol. Product identity was confirmed by electrospray ionization–mass spectrometry.
goal: to synthesize desthiobiotin derivatives of thiazole orange acetate
key_materials: EZ link amine PEG4 desthiobiotin (Thermo Fisher)

title: Prepare TO1-Dtb derivatized streptavidin agarose resin
description: Streptavidin agarose beads were washed with Buffer A and Buffer B, then incubated with TO1-Dtb in Buffer B for 15 min at room temperature. Beads were washed to remove unbound dye.
goal: to prepare TO1-Dtb derivatized streptavidin agarose affinity resin
key_materials: 0.1 M NaOH and 0.05 M NaCl (Buffer A)
15 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 90 mM KCl (Buffer B)

title: Prepare yeast strains and whole-cell extracts
description: The U1M gene was subcloned into pRS413 and transformed into yeast strain yAAH0441. Transformants were selected and confirmed by PCR and sequencing. Whole-cell extracts were prepared using liquid nitrogen and a ball mill.
goal: to prepare yeast strains and whole-cell extracts

title: Label yeast whole-cell extract with SNAP-Surface 549
description: Yeast whole-cell extracts were incubated with SNAP-Surface 549 tag, RNase inhibitor, protease inhibitors, and DTT in Buffer B at room temperature for 30 min to fluorescently label the extracts.
goal: to fluorescently label yeast whole-cell extracts with SNAP tag

title: Pull-down U1M-associated snRNPs using TO1-Dtb beads
description: Yeast extracts were incubated with TO1-Dtb agarose beads at 4°C for 1 h, washed multiple times with Buffer B, and eluted with Buffer B containing biotin at 37°C. Eluates were analyzed by SDS-PAGE and RT-primer extension.
goal: to pull down U1M-associated snRNP complexes

title: Analyze RNA by RT-primer extension and solution hybridization
description: RNA samples were reverse transcribed using labeled primers and Maxima Reverse Transcriptase at 45°C for 1 h, then analyzed by denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis. Solution hybridization was performed by incubating labeled primers with RNA prior to native gel electrophoresis.
goal: to analyze RNA by RT-primer extension and solution hybridization

title: Construct p6SRDM_T7 plasmid
description: The 6SRDM plasmid with point mutations was cloned into pEcoli-Cterm-6xHN plasmid between SgrAI and ClaI sites, flanked by T7 promoter and lac operator at 5′ end and intrinsic terminator at 3′ end.
goal: to construct the p6SRDM_T7 plasmid

title: Express 6SRDM RNA in E. coli and prepare native extract
description: E. coli transformed with p6SRDM_T7 were grown and induced with IPTG to express 6SRDM RNA. Cells were harvested, resuspended in native extract buffer, lysed by French press, centrifuged to remove debris, and the extract was frozen for storage.
goal: to express 6SRDM RNA in E. coli and prepare native extract
key_materials: Native extract buffer (20 mM Tris pH 8, 150 mM KCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 1 mM DTT)

title: Virus Strain Preparation
description: Four DENV strains and other flaviviruses along with respiratory viruses were obtained from various sources to establish and evaluate the novel DENV RT-LAMP assay and its cross-reactivity.
key_materials: Respiratory viruses (adenovirus VR-930, enterovirus VR-1076, influenza A VR-333, influenza B VR-789, parainfluenza virus 3 VR-93, HCoV-229E VR-740, HCoV-OC43 VR-1558, human rhinovirus VR-489)

title: Viral RNA Extraction
description: Viral RNA was extracted from 140 μl of virus culture supernatants or patients’ plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit, eluted in 50 μl nuclease-free water, and stored at -80°C until use.

title: Mutant Viral RNA Template Construction
description: Mutants forming mismatches with primers were constructed based on the 3′-UTR region of DENV-4 by PCR amplification, sub-cloning, site-directed mutagenesis, in vitro transcription, and quantification by spectrophotometry.
goal: to perform proof-of-concept experiment of mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar, Beijing, China)

title: Construct mismatch mutants of DENV-4 3'-UTR
description: The 3'-UTR fragment of DENV-4 was amplified and sub-cloned into a plasmid vector. Site-directed mutagenesis was performed to create mutants with mismatches to primers, confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Mutant RNAs were transcribed in vitro and quantified by spectrophotometry.
goal: to perform the proof-of-concept experiment of the mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar, Beijing, China)

title: Establish novel mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP assay
description: A 25 μl reaction mix containing Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, WarmStart RT, and optimized Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase was prepared with specific primers and fluorescent dye. The RT-LAMP reaction was performed at 63°C for 60 minutes with real-time fluorescence monitoring.

title: Determine sensitivity and limit of detection of RT-LAMP
description: Ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA from four DENV stocks were used to assess sensitivity. RNA copy numbers were quantified by RT-qPCR. Limit of detection was determined by testing replicates of serial dilutions and analyzed by probit regression.
key_materials: RNA from DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4 stocks

title: Evaluate RT-LAMP assay with clinical plasma samples
description: Clinical samples were tested for DENV infection by NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR. Positive samples underwent Sanger sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. Samples with discordant results between assays were further analyzed by RT-nested PCR and sequencing.
key_materials: One-Step Dengue NS1 RapiDip InstaTest kit
PrimeScript One Step RT-PCR Kit Ver.2 (Takara)
StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar)

title: Develop visual detection methods for RT-LAMP
description: Visual detection was developed by adding HNB dye to RT-LAMP reactions and using a colorimetric LAMP master mix with cresol red. Reactions were incubated at 63°C and color changes were observed at multiple time points.

title: Grow E. coli strains
description: Escherichia coli NEB5α and BL21(DE3) strains were grown in LB broth with aeration at 250 rpm.
goal: to culture E. coli strains for experiments

title: Transform plasmids into E. coli
description: Plasmids were introduced into E. coli cells by electroporation, and transformants were selected by plating on LB agar containing the appropriate antibiotic and incubated at 37°C overnight.
goal: to introduce plasmids into E. coli cells

title: Grow M. smegmatis strain MC2 155
description: M. smegmatis MC2 155 was used for experiments under specified conditions described later.

title: Construct plasmids with DnaBi1 insertion
description: M. smegmatis DnaBi1 was inserted in-frame into kanR of pUC4K using Gibson assembly. DNA was amplified with CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix and visualized with EZ-Vision DNA dye. Plasmids were prepared using an E.Z.N.A. minikit.
goal: to create plasmids containing DnaBi1 inserted into kanR

title: Verify plasmid clones by sequencing
description: All plasmid clones were verified by DNA sequencing to confirm correct construction.

title: Construct MBP-intein-GFP (MIG) reporter plasmids
description: The MIG reporter for M. smegmatis and M. leprae DnaBi1 was constructed previously and contains the intein flanked by native DnaB extein residues.

title: Screen KanR-DnaBi1 (KD) fusions for splicing-dependent resistance
description: Sixteen KD constructs and their splicing-inactive C118A variants were grown on LB media with carbenicillin and a range of kanamycin concentrations to identify splicing-dependent resistance phenotypes by measuring colony forming units.
goal: to identify KD constructs requiring splicing for kanamycin resistance

title: Screen KD fusions for kanamycin resistance
description: All 16 KD constructs and their splicing-inactive counterparts were grown on LB media containing carbenicillin and various concentrations of kanamycin to identify candidates requiring splicing for survival.
goal: to identify candidates that require splicing for survival on kanamycin-containing media

title: Purify Polyclonal and Monoclonal Antibodies
description: Polyclonal ACPA IgGs and control IgGs were purified from pooled and non-pooled sera of RA patients. Polyclonal anti-PR3 IgGs and controls were purified from vasculitis patient sera. Monoclonal antibodies were isolated from RA patients and recombinantly expressed as IgG1. All IgGs underwent quality control including specificity, size exclusion chromatography, and LAL endotoxin tests.
goal: to purify and quality control antibodies for experiments
key_materials: pooled serum of patients with RA
sera of patient with PR3-associated vasculitis

title: Generate F(ab’)2 Antibody Fragments
description: F(ab’)2 antibody fragments were generated from IgGs. RF IgM antibody was purchased for use in experiments.

title: Culture Fibroblasts and Obtain Synovial Biopsies
description: Fibroblasts derived from RA, OA, and human dermis were cultured for cell experiments. Synovial biopsies were obtained from healthy volunteers and RA patients with ethical approval and informed consent.

title: Assess Fibroblast Migration and Adhesion
description: Fibroblast migration was measured using live cell imaging or scratch assay. Adhesion assays were performed with E-plates and real-time cell analyzer. Cells were washed with PBS and starved in serum-free medium when indicated.
goal: to assess fibroblast migration and adhesion properties
key_materials: IncuCyte Zoom live cell imaging system

title: Pretreat Antibodies with Citrullinated or Native Proteins
description: Citrullinated or native purified proteins were added as pretreatment to ACPA and control IgGs at 4°C overnight before use in assays.

title: Inhibit PI3K, PTEN, PAD, and Histone Modification Enzymes
description: PI3K was inhibited by wortmanin, PTEN by SF-1670. PAD activity was inhibited by Cl-amidine or GSK199 for 72 hours prior to scratch assay. Histone acetyltransferase and deacetylase enzymes were inhibited by anacardic acid and trichostatin A respectively.

title: Culture Fibroblasts with Cytokines
description: Fibroblasts were cultured in the presence or absence of IL-8 or TNF-α to study cytokine effects.

title: Analyze Cytokine and MMP Levels
description: Cytokine levels were analyzed using Cytometric Bead Array and matrix metalloproteinases were measured by ELISA.

title: Peptidomics analysis of soybean xylem exudate
description: Performed peptidomics analysis to identify root-to-shoot long-distance mobile peptides in soybean xylem exudate.

title: Nano-LC–MS/MS analysis of Arabidopsis xylem exudate
description: Collected Arabidopsis xylem exudate and performed nano-LC–MS/MS to detect mature CLE2 peptide and confirm its root-to-shoot translocation.
goal: to explore whether the Arabidopsis CLE peptide is translocated from roots to shoots via the xylem

title: Expression analysis of CLE2 under low-carbon conditions
description: Measured CLE2 mRNA levels in plants treated with photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU or prolonged darkness, with or without sucrose application, to assess response to low-carbon conditions.
goal: to examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions

title: Sugar and starch content measurement in CLE mutants
description: Measured sucrose, glucose, and starch contents in roots and leaves of various CLE mutants to characterize CLE2 function in carbon source signaling.

title: Generation of cle2cle3 double and cle1-7 septuple mutants
description: Created cle2cle3 double mutant and cle1-7 septuple mutant using CRISPR/Cas9 to analyze overlapping biological activities of CLE peptides.

title: Gain-of-function analysis of CLE2 using CoYMV promoter
description: Ectopically expressed CLE2 under CoYMV promoter in vascular tissues and measured sucrose levels in roots and leaves to assess CLE2 function.

title: Application of synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis
description: Applied synthetic CLE2 peptide to rosette leaves of WT and cle1-7 plants and measured starch and sugar contents in shoots and roots after 24 hours.

title: Measurement of shoot and root mass in cle mutants
description: Evaluated shoot and root biomass and shoot/root mass ratio under normal and diurnally fluctuating light conditions with or without sucrose supplementation.
goal: to explore the effect of decreased root sucrose levels on root growth

title: Prepare Neuronal Cultures from Mouse Embryos
description: Cortical and hippocampal neuron cultures were prepared from mouse embryos collected in dissection media and cultivated in neuronal complete medium. High-density neuronal cultures were plated on coverslips placed in 24-well plates to reduce glial growth.
key_materials: Dissection media (HBSS 1×, 6 mM MgSO4, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 10 μg/ml gentamicin)
Neuronal complete medium (Neurobasal 1×, B27 supplement 1×, 0.5 mM L-glutamine, 10 μg/ml gentamicin)

title: Transduce Neuronal Cultures with Lentivirus
description: Primary neuronal cultures were transduced at day in vitro 4 (DIV4) with GFP-expressing pLVTH virus at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 2.

title: Treat Neurons with Growth Factors
description: Neurons were treated with 10 ng/ml FGFb and 5 ng/ml EGF for 10 minutes to stimulate cellular responses.

title: Perform MTT Reduction Assay for Viability
description: Cortical cultures were seeded in 96-well plates and incubated for 24 hours. MTT was added to a final concentration of 0.25 mg/ml and incubated for 2 hours at 37°C. Formazan precipitates were solubilized in DMSO and absorbance measured at 570 nm to assess cell viability.
goal: to measure culture viability

title: Neuron Lysis and Protein Extraction
description: Neurons were washed in PBS and lysed in RIPA buffer under mild agitation for 1 hour at 4°C. The lysate was clarified by centrifugation at 16,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.

title: Protein Quantification by Bradford Assay
description: Protein concentration in the lysate samples was measured using the standard Bradford assay.

title: Western Blotting for Protein Identification
description: Equal amounts of protein samples were diluted with Laemmli buffer, loaded onto SDS-PAGE gels, and transferred to nitrocellulose membranes. Membranes were incubated overnight with primary antibodies in blocking buffer and proteins were detected using ECL.
goal: to identify and quantify proteins via Western blotting

title: Immunofluorescence Staining and Imaging
description: Neuronal cultures were incubated with Mitosox Red to assess mitochondrial superoxide, fixed with paraformaldehyde and sucrose, and immunostained for synaptic markers. Fluorescence images were acquired using confocal microscopes at various magnifications.
